features.name: Add subscription from service catalog
features.description: Add sheet with a searchable catalog of popular services (name, logo, category, default cycle) plus 'custom'. Picking a service pre-fills name, category and cycle; the user sets price, currency, cycle and next payment date.
features.reason: Pure local data bundled in the app. Service brand logos are third-party trademarks: Sbu shows a neutral monogram or SF Symbol per category unless the logo decision says otherwise.

features.name: Custom subscription
features.description: Free-form entry with name, price, currency, billing cycle, start date / next payment date, category, list, payment method, URL and notes.
features.reason: SwiftData model and a native Form.

features.name: Billing cycles
features.description: Daily, weekly, monthly, yearly and custom intervals (every N days/weeks/months/years); next payment computed from start date and cycle, end-of-month safe.
features.reason: Pure date arithmetic with Calendar, tested with Swift Testing.

features.name: Monthly and yearly totals
features.description: Home shows the count of subscriptions and the yearly total (toggle to monthly), normalising every cycle to the same period; remaining payments this month.
features.reason: The one figure of the app: total per month or year in the main currency. Decimal math, FormatStyle currency.

features.name: Multiple currencies with conversion
features.description: 64 currencies; each subscription keeps its own currency, totals shown in a main currency with live conversion rates.
features.reason: Per-subscription currency and Locale-aware formatting are core. Live rates need the network: Sbu uses rates entered by the user (or a bundled table refreshed per release); decision in a grilling.

features.name: Renewal reminders
features.description: Local notification before each payment (same day, 1, 3, 7 days or custom), at a chosen time; none for canceled or paused subscriptions.
features.reason: UNUserNotificationCenter calendar triggers, rescheduled on each change and at launch (64 pending limit). Reviews of Orbit and Bobby show broken notifications as the top failure.

features.name: Free trial tracking
features.description: Mark a subscription as a free trial with an end date and the price after the trial; separate 'Free trials' section on home; alert before the trial converts.
features.reason: Local data plus local notification.

features.name: Payment calendar
features.description: Month grid with each renewal on its day, totals for the month and for the remaining payments; tap a day to see payments, long-press to add from that date.
features.reason: SwiftUI grid built from computed occurrences; no EventKit needed.

features.name: Subscription detail
features.description: Sheet with name, price, cycle, trial end, next payment, category, list, payment method, URL, notes, price history and billing history; Edit button.
features.reason: Native List/Form.

features.name: Price history
features.description: Record price changes with an effective date; future changes apply only from their date and totals follow.
features.reason: Child entity in SwiftData; useful but secondary.

features.name: Billing history / timeline
features.description: Timeline of key events: subscribed, paused, resumed, canceled, renewed.
features.reason: Derived from dates and status changes; local.

features.name: Cancel and pause
features.description: Mark as canceled (kept in history, out of totals and reminders) or paused; completed one-time or fixed-length payment plans.
features.reason: Status enum on the model; excludes reminders and totals.

features.name: One-time payments and fixed payment plans
features.description: Track a payment that happens once, or N installments, without treating it as an active renewal.
features.reason: Extends the cycle model with an end date / installment count.

features.name: Categories
features.description: Default categories (streaming, music, productivity, cloud, utilities such as water, electricity, gas, internet, rent, mortgage, insurance) editable in Settings; filter and group by category.
features.reason: SwiftData entity, SF Symbols per category.

features.name: Lists (Personal, Family, Business)
features.description: Custom lists to separate groups of subscriptions; home and widget filter by list; totals per list.
features.reason: Local organisation only; in Orbit it is a Plus feature.

features.name: Payment methods
features.description: User-defined payment methods (card name, PayPal, bank) to filter and group by.
features.reason: Free text labels only, never card numbers.

features.name: Sorting, filtering and grouping on home
features.description: Sort by next payment, name, price (normalised); group by billing cycle; collapsible sections; preferences remembered.
features.reason: Pure sorting on the model, @AppStorage for preferences.

features.name: Search subscriptions
features.description: Search the list by name (on the Orbit roadmap).
features.reason: .searchable on the native list.

features.name: Mark as paid
features.description: Confirm a payment happened (on the Orbit roadmap, requested in Bobby reviews).
features.reason: Billing event in SwiftData.

features.name: Home screen widgets
features.description: Upcoming payments widget (small: remaining this month and next 3; medium/large: list), all lists or one list; refreshes daily.
features.reason: WidgetKit with an App Group store. In Orbit widgets are a Plus feature.

features.name: Siri, Shortcuts and Spotlight
features.description: Ask price, next renewal, upcoming payments and count; open a subscription, the calendar or Add; find subscriptions in Spotlight.
features.reason: App Intents with AppEntity and AppShortcutsProvider (iOS 17); IndexedEntity for Spotlight on iOS 18 when available.

features.name: CSV export
features.description: Settings > Export subscriptions to a CSV file through the share sheet.
features.reason: Local file via ShareLink / fileExporter; it is the backup without an account.

features.name: CSV import
features.description: Import subscriptions from a CSV file with a review step before saving.
features.reason: fileImporter and a pure parser, on device. Also the migration path from other trackers.

features.name: iCloud sync
features.description: Sync subscriptions across the user's Apple devices.
features.reason: Allowed by ADR-0008 as an opt-in in Settings, off by default: SwiftData with CloudKit private database.

features.name: Magic Import from screenshots, PDFs and bank statements
features.description: Removes personal data on device, then sends the text to an AI service to identify subscriptions and logos; the user reviews suggestions before saving.
features.reason: Requires a network AI service. An on-device variant (Vision text recognition plus a local matcher against the catalog) is a separate decision.

features.name: Guided setup / subscription finder
features.description: Checklist of popular services to tick during onboarding, with typical prices, to build the first list quickly.
features.reason: Pure local catalog; no import from accounts.

features.name: Cancellation help
features.description: Link to where each service is canceled; Orbit only offers guides on its website, users ask for it in-app.
features.reason: A URL field per subscription and Apple's manage subscriptions sheet (StoreKit showManageSubscriptions) for App Store subscriptions; links open Safari.

features.name: Logo search and custom icons
features.description: Search logos online for services not in the catalog; import icons from the App Store (roadmap).
features.reason: Network and third-party trademarks.

features.name: Shared lists with family or friends
features.description: Share a list with other people (in progress in Orbit).
features.reason: Needs CloudKit sharing between accounts; out of 'one thing' for now, possible future grilling.

features.name: Animated planet diagram
features.description: Home hero with a planet and orbiting subscription moons; tap the sun to switch moons to logos.
features.reason: Decorative brand visual; copying it conflicts with guideline 4.1 and the design system (one figure on paper).

features.name: Orbit Plus paywall
features.description: One-time or annual purchase unlocking unlimited subscriptions, widgets, lists, iCloud and Magic Import.
features.reason: Sbu has no in-app purchases.

features.name: Analytics and crash reporting
features.description: Mixpanel and Firebase Crashlytics.
features.reason: No analytics or third-party SDKs.

features.name: Bank linking and email scanning
features.description: Not in Orbit; offered by competitors such as Rocket Money.
features.reason: Accounts, servers and network.

flows.name: First launch
steps: Value screens (find all subscriptions, hidden costs)
Magic Import or guided setup offered
Home with first subscriptions; paywall when exceeding the free limit

flows.name: Add a subscription
steps: Search or pick a service, or Custom
Enter price, currency, cycle, payment date
Optionally mark free trial, choose reminder, category, list

flows.name: Trial ending
steps: Notification the day before: trial ends, amount that will be charged
Cancel with the provider, then mark canceled in the app

flows.name: Change price
steps: Set new price and its effective date
Price history records the change; totals use it from that date

fields.name: effectiveDate
fields.note: future changes apply from this date

fields.name: kind
fields.note: subscribed, renewed, paused, resumed, canceled, paid

data_model.storage: On device. Orbit: local store with iCloud sync for Plus, CSV export. Sbu: SwiftData in an App Group container (widgets), optional CloudKit private database (ADR-0008), CSV export/import; migrate the 1.0 Expo SQLite file (Documents/SQLite/sbu_subscriptions.db) on first launch.

monetization.model: Freemium: free download with a limit on tracked subscriptions, Orbit Plus as in-app purchase (one-time and annual options).
monetization.price: US: Orbit Plus $12.99, Orbit Plus Annual $19.99, Orbit Plus Lifetime $24.99 and $39.99; AU Lifetime from $29.99. Family Sharing on some purchases.
paywalled_features: More than 3-5 subscriptions (reviews: 5 at launch, 3 in version 1.1.8)
Magic Import (type or paste explicitly Plus; document import advertised as the main value)
Widgets (opened to all users to try since the iOS 26 update, listed as Plus in the description)
monetization.notes: Paywall appears early, as soon as the free limit is reached; reviews call the free tier useless. Analytics via Mixpanel and Crashlytics.
